title: OpenAI's 'Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence'. Six Referees for Five Theorems a Day, and the First Bet on This Site to Settle.
short_version: A correction first: the Navier-Stokes proof did come out, the day WE said it hadn't, and that settled the site's first bet. Then the new page: six unpaid mathematicians will advise on when the world sees the next hundred theorems, and on everything except how fast they arrive.
